1_i can't lie: i was bored throughout the 112 minutes i spent watching lu over the wall.

2_the film has a scrappy, sometimes cheap look to it (characters look flat, like thin-lined etch-a-sketch drawings, superimposed over more colorful hand-painted backgrounds), for which it more than compensates via other strengths ...
3_ he is clearly an artist with an individual vision whose work offers something genuinely new and eye-catching.
4_what the film gains in energy, it loses in the kinds of expressive details that make two-dimensional figures seem like they breathe three-dimensional life.
5_even by anime standards, lu over the wall is best enjoyed by disconnecting your logic circuits and just enjoying the pretty colors and sounds.
7_throughout the film, yuasa's eye for vivid colors and slapsticky antics lead the way.
